main_body: A flat-roofed sandstone building. The sand terrace roof carries a teal dome, and the brick front wall below has an arched door and a lattice window.
top_band: Sand/tan roof surface, rows ~2-33, lightest tone with speckles. A pale front-edge lip sits at rows ~30-33.
evidence: Down the middle column there is a large light sand roof surface, a lighter front-edge lip at rows ~30-33, then a dark brown eave band at rows ~34-36 over the brick front wall (rows ~36-65). The dome has its own base slab sitting on the roof. The door has a pale frame and a dark inner top edge, and the window has a sill, so the openings read as inset. The roof is tall for a foreshortened top but clearly reads as a horizontal terrace seen from above, so both a top and a front face are drawn.

style.evidence: The outlines are dark brown beside the sand and brick, so they are tinted material tones. The dome has about five teal steps and the roof has speckle texture. The brick wall is mostly flat 2-3 tone blocks, each a single colour over areas of about 10x4 px or more with little grain. The pale door frame is a flat cream sticker-like outline, and the roof has large calm sand areas. Overall it is thinner and flatter than the Beodeul reference houses, which have per-tile highlights and 5-6 steps per material.
